content.title: Hurry Up Whiskey — acoustic hook to camera
content.hook: Some nights the whiskey can't come fast enough.
content.body: Wrote this one for the nights you're trying to catch up to a feeling. Hurry Up Whiskey — out now, and there's an acoustic version if you like it stripped all the way down.
content.cta: Full song out now — wherever you stream.

content.title: Story behind If Trucks Could Talk
content.hook: That old truck saw everything before I ever wrote a word about it.
content.body: Every dent's got a night attached to it. If Trucks Could Talk is off the We're All Here record — here's where it came from.
content.cta: It's on the We're All Here record — link in bio.

content.title: We're All Here — title track reel
content.hook: Twelve songs, one idea: we're all here, so let's mean it.
content.body:
The We're All Here record is twelve songs about the people in the room and the miles it took to get there. If you've been rocking with the singles, this is the whole thing.

Start with the title track and let it ride.
content.cta: Whole record's out now — link in bio.

content.title: You, Me and God — Sunday post
content.hook: Three things that have never once let me down.
content.body:
Wrote You, Me and God about the short list that actually holds a life together. If it's your kind of song, turn it up this morning and share it with somebody who'd get it.

Off the We're All Here record. Grateful for every one of you.
content.cta: Turn it up and tag somebody who needs to hear it.

content.title: What "neo-traditional" means (identity carousel)
content.hook: People ask what kind of country I make. Here's the honest answer.
content.body:
Neo-traditional — which is a fancy way of saying I took what Waylon and Merle built and wrote my own songs on top of it. Baritone, steel, and stories that actually happened.

If that's your lane, you're in the right place. Welcome in.
content.cta: Follow along — plenty more where this came from.

content.title: Tailgate Talkin' — singalong / participation prompt
content.hook: If you know the tailgate part, this one's a duet.
content.body: Tailgate Talkin' is made for a parking lot and a cooler. Duet this and sing the hook back at me — best ones get reposted.
content.cta: Duet it and sing the hook back — best ones get reposted.

content.title: Acoustic session — 3 songs, one take (long-form)
content.hook: Three songs off the record, just me and the guitar.
content.body:
Sat down and played three off We're All Here the way they got written — one guitar, one take, no click. If you've only heard the studio versions, this is the other half of the story.

Chapters below. Full record's linked in the description.
content.cta: Full record's linked in the description — hit subscribe for more sessions.

content.title: Better Off — the debut record, where it started
content.hook: Everybody's got a first record. This one's mine.
content.body:
Better Off was the debut — the songs I had to get out before I could write anything else. Rough around the edges in the best way. Still proud of every one of them.

Start there if you want to hear where this all began.
